dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About apprenticeships...

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: Ah, you must have overheard me grumbling, then?

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: Haha, my new apprentice, Dayu, is quite quick with his hands, and he's hardworking enough. He just talks too much.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: Carpenters like us should just focus on getting the work done with our own two hands. No need to flap those lips unnecessarily.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: That kid is pretty unreliable in that regard. Perhaps I should get myself another apprentice...

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: I mean, with the two of them helping and covering for each others' weaknesses, the future of Fanmu Carpenter's will be secure.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: ...Speaking of which, would you be interested in carpentry?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, Master!

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: Really? Do you mean it?

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: I don't know... You seem to me to have itchy feet. Places you have to go, things you have to do.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: How about you do what you've gotta do first. If I'm still around when you come back, then I'll be glad to take you on, so long as I've got strength in my bones.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: When that time comes, I will devote myself fully to passing on everything I know. All the tricks of the trade of the Fanmu Carpenter's will be yours.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: What a pity. You'll never know the joy of working with wood.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: Well, never mind. It's clear that you've got places to go, things to do.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: When you've done what you've gotta do, though... do come and find me if you change your mind.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: I'd devote myself fully to passing on everything I know. All the tricks of the trade of the Fanmu Carpenter shall be yours to take if you want them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: Playing with you was rather relaxing indeed. Let's have another round sometime!

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: Good, good! Young people are indeed good at cards!

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: *sigh* ...

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: Welcome to the Fanmu Carpenter's, one of the oldest carpentry workshops in Qingce Village!

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: You name it, I build it, whether it's a yo-yo or a new house!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A carpentry workshop?

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: That's right! It began as my grandfather's grandfather's workshop and it's stayed in the family ever since.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: Chang the Ninth's residence? The Fanmu Carpenter's built that. The village mill? We built that too!

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: Even the Qixing come to us when they need some new furniture built to order.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About apprenticeships...

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: *sigh* You must have overheard me grumbling then...

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: I'm getting old now, and a lifetime of toiling away in this workshop has started to take its toll on the old joints...

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: Lately I've been thinking — it's time for me to take on an apprentice. Pass on what I've learned. Secure the future of the Fanmu Carpenter's.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: ...Don't s'pose you have any interest in woodwork yourself? The thought of turning a chunk of raw timber into a polished masterpiece by your own handiwork... appeal to you at all?

response.text: I'd devote myself fully to passing on everything I know. All the tricks of the trade of the Fanmu Carpenter's, they're yours to take if you want them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: Leaving so soon? *sigh* Seems like for every new customer I get, I lose another one...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you help me with some furnishings?

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: Hmm? You want some furnishings made? Well, it just so happens that the Fanmu Carpenter's have got some new blueprints in. Feel free to take a look through them...
